answer: Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The prism counter is kept in relic and canyon shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4253 identities would post 3897 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
